steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: What? Sir Enciodes was attacked in the mountains yesterday?!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: Huh? Is that true?

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Of course it's true. Sir Arctosz had General Gulo rush people over to report to the Great Elder.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: The other nephew of my third uncle came back with General Gulo.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: They arrived just now, and I heard the news from him.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: What a good lad. Now that's some big news!

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Heh!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: But, who would be so foolhardy as to attack Sir Enciodes? On his way to the Holy Hunt, no less!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: Do you think it could've been a Tschäggättä?

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: How the hell could've it been a Tschäggättä? Didn't we already say a person did it?

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: If you ask me, it must've been the doing of the Paleroches or the Browntails.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: They tried so hard to suppress the Silverashes, saying something about how Sir Enciodes had trampled upon our teachings.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: But who knows, maybe they were really after the Silverash clan's land.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: I wouldn't go around making spurious claims like that.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: Spurious? Do you have any idea how much Silverash land the Browntail clan gobbled up after Sir Enciodes left Kjerag to study abroad?

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: Now that Sir Enciodes has had a change of heart and took the initiative to show favor to the Saintess, the other two clans are panicking because they no longer have an excuse to keep the Silverashes down.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Wh-Who do you belong to?!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: I'm with the Browntail clan. So what?

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: You're a Browntail? How can you say those things about your own clan?!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: Because I've been working down in the valley for so long, I honestly feel that Sir Enciodes has been wronged!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: Sir Enciodes has brought so many good things to Kjerag, but has been kept down in the Tri-Clan Council.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: Even now after he has offered to return to the government and taken the initiative to repair his relationship with the Vine-Bead Court and the Saintess, look how they treat him.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: Even if you're a Paleroche, does that not make your conscience ache?

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: You have a point...

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: That's right. No matter what the circumstances are, an attack on Sir Enciodes is simply going too far.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: Besides, to do it during a ceremony as important as the Holy Hunt is also a grave insult to Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: Exactly! No matter what the facts are regarding this situation, there must be some kind of explanation!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: You said it.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: That's right, the perpetrator must be found!

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: What's wrong? Didn't sleep well last night? You don't look so good.

options: Enciodes ended up running into trouble after all.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Mm. Word of it has spread, and everyone's talking about.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I can see that many people are already demanding an explanation for this matter.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Judging from the look on your face, did you not expect this at all?

options: It's precisely because I DID expect it.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Huh? Then what's got you in a twist?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Gnosis doesn't see eye to eye with Enciodes, and he's been plotting to overthrow him since they parted ways.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: You didn't think Enciodes would leave himself so open, nor did you want to interfere in the affairs of the three clans, so you came to the ceremony as a guest.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I'm just talking about superficial appearances here. From that angle, that is how the situation seems, right?

options: Everyone has a skewed understanding of the situation.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: I don't have a clue what goes on in that head of yours all day.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But I feel like you've infected me into enjoying thinking about these things, so let's do just that.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Hmm... Since Enciodes used to be good friends with Gnosis and we know the latter to be a crafty man, he must've been prepared for Gnosis's betrayal from the very beginning.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But he was attacked anyway, and it became a pretty big deal...

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: In other words, he engineered this situation to become more sympathetic in the eyes of the public?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: But, what exactly does this accomplish?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Right now, the Holy Hunt party should be on its way back.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Shortly, the Grand Ceremony come to its final ritual, including the ceremonial crowning of the Saintess.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: If he can catch the perpetrator at the ceremony, that'll increase people's faith in Enciodes... but that's it, right?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: What would that be?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: The Saintess shot and killed the prey herself during the Holy Hunt?

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: And news of the attack on Enciodes has already spread among the people.

steps.name: Elder B
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: Not only that, but a number of people are demanding that the perpetrator be punished before the coronation ceremony.

steps.name: Elder C
steps.text: To injure a countryman during the Holy Hunt is to gravely disrespect Kjeragandr. Of course this deserves punishment!

steps.name: Elder B
steps.text: But, this is still the Saintess's coronation ceremony.

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: Both of you bring up good points... Great Elder, your judgment?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Given Enciodes's superb abilities, there is little chance that the mastermind behind this will not be sniffed out, regardless of who it is––

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: If only things were that simple.

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: Please do explain, Great Elder.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: The Saintess's behavior has gone increasingly out-of-line, yet Enciodes's response has been quite uncharacteristic.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: What are those siblings planning?

steps.name: Elder A
steps.text: What does the Great Elder mean by 'those siblings?'

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: No, there is no possibility of any collusion between the two.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: But perhaps, this is the Silverash blood that runs through their veins––

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: Everyone, the Elders, the Great Elder, and the Saintess's teams are about to arrive.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Enough. Let's go to meet the Saintess.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: Hurry, it's the Holy Hunt party!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: Look, Sir Enciodes's wounds have been bandaged!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: The rumors were true after all!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: Great Saintess, please deliver justice for Sir Enciodes!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: Find the perpetrator who sabotaged the Holy Hunt!

steps.name: Kjerag Noble A
steps.text: Matriarch Ratatos and Sir Arctosz appear ill at ease.

steps.name: Kjerag Noble B
steps.text: Might they be connected in some way to this incident?

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: The Great Elder is here!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: The Vine-Bead Court must uphold justice for Sir Enciodes!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: We won't accept this ceremony if you just try to sweep things under the rug and move on!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: My friends, I am very grateful for your concern.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Though the perpetrator has not been found yet, it is only a matter of time.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: For now, let us first prioritize the ceremony.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What say you, Saintess?

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: As Sir Enciodes is so faithful to Kjeragandr, I have no objections.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Then, children of Kjeragandr, know that this year's ceremony holds a different meaning.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: The proposal by the head of the Silverash clan, Enciodes, to have the Saintess restored to power passed the previous Tri-Clan Council, and this was announced throughout our territory.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: And today, on the day of Kjerag's grandest celebration, we hold the coronation ceremony for the Saintess.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: This will also be the last ceremony that I preside over.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Kjeragandr gave Her own flesh to the Paleroche clan, making the land fertile so that the people of Kjerag would go hungry no longer.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Valais.

steps.name: Valais
steps.text: Sir.
I am a researcher. Even should I lie, I would never lie about my research.
You may distrust the results of my analysis, yet you still hold onto my sample from back then.
You can use it as an experiment, to verify the things that I said.
Or, are you ready to accept this 'truth?'
Do you truly believe that your father died for 'blaspheming Kjeragandr?'
Valais respectfully brings forth a cup of wine.
This cup represents a bountiful harvest.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I offer this wine made from nourishing grain to Kjeragandr, so that we may be blessed with a bountiful harvest next year.
The Great Elder receives the wine and drinks it in one gulp.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: As head of the Paleroche clan, I, Arctosz Paleroche, pay the highest tribute to Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Your prayers will surely reach Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Kjeragandr gave Her own hide to the Browntail clan, making the forests lush and full of beast-life so that the people of Kjerag would no longer succumb to the cold.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Yucatan.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Matriarch.
Yucatan respectfully brings forth a scarf.
This scarf represents comfort and good health.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I offer this cloth knit from warming fur to Kjeragandr, so that we may be blessed with comfort and good health next year.
The Great Elder takes the scarf and drapes it across the Saintess.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: As head of the Browntail clan, I, Ratatos Browntail, pay the highest tribute to Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Your prayers will surely reach Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Finally, Kjeragandr gave Her own bones to the Silverash clan, making the mountains rich with metal so that the people of Kjerag could forge tools and weapons.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Matterhorn.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir.
Matterhorn respectfully brings forth a small knife.
This small knife represents peace.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I offer this weapon of refined ore to Kjeragandr, so that we may be blessed with peace next year.
The Great Elder takes the knife and hands it to the Saintess with both hands.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As head of the Silverash clan, I, Enciodes Silverash, pay the highest tribute to Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Your prayers will surely reach Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Next––

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Master, the perpetrator has been found.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Great Elder, now that the perpetrator has been found, I know not whether to continue the ceremony or interrogate the perpetrator.

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: This perpetrator must be brought to justice!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: That's right! The perpetrator must be punished!

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Since the people worry about this matter, bring the perpetrator.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Come.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Monch?!)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (What's going on? Why is Monch in custody? D-Does this have something to do with the assassination attempt?!)

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Dammit, that idiot!)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (Wait, Rus, what are you doing?!)

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Assassin who dares disrupt the Holy Hunt, state your name.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Why... *could* *cough*... would you seek to take Sir Enciodes's life?

steps.name: Monch
steps.text: I kill what needs to die.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Assassin, keeping your mouth shut will not spare your life.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Your sacrilege against Kjeragandr during a sacred ceremony is a sin that must be punished accordingly.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Know that if you persist, then by the Commandments, I can order your execution on the spot!

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Fine. Then you shall be dealt with according to the Commandments.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Even if you choose not to speak, your identity will not be difficult to uncover.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Wait, hold on!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Sciurus!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan, what are you doing? Let go of me!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Monch is one of my people! I won't let you hurt her!

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Is this true, Sciurus?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: ...Sciurus! You get back here this instant!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: This isn't the time or place to be fooling around. Yucatan, get your wife under control!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: ...Rus, you don't understand the situation. Let's not make a scene here, alright?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Come, over here, by me.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: What am I not understanding? And I am not making a scene!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: They're all like that. If I didn't speak up, they would've condemned Monch as an assassin!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Silence!!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Ratatos, I...

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Looks like that saves us the trouble of identifying the assassin.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: Detain Sciurus.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: W-Wait, why are you arresting me?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: I'm telling you, I never had Monch do anything of the sort! Someone must be trying to frame us!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Great Elder, surely it cannot be appropriate to use force against a member of the Browntail clan solely due to the words of an insignificant person who knows nothing of the situation.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: As you can see, my stupid little sister could not possibly seek to assassinate Sir Enciodes, for she clearly lacks the brain cells to do so.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Hey, what are you trying to say?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I told you to shut up!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: (...Sciurus, know your place.)

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: What, you mean to say that your sister has been deceived, Ratotos? Do you not find something unusual about that?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Very perceptive, Great Elder.

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Enciodes... *cough*... What do you think?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ratatos has always treated me kindly. and I have always trusted her. Even if we have our differences, I believe she would not resort to such drastic measures.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Ratatos, I have no reason to believe you to be of so little faith as to behave in such a manner during a celebration of Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: While my well-being is of little consequence, this disrespect to Kjeragandr cannot be tolerated.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: What do you mean by that?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Now that we know that the perpetrator is a member of the Browntail clan, no one will believe the empty rhetoric that the Browntails have nothing to do with this matter.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Without providing some concrete evidence, or turning over the real perpetrator, even if I am willing to turn the other cheek... I'm afraid that the house of Browntail will be hard-pressed to convince the public.
Ratatos feels that she can understand the man's meaning, but the buzzing of those words inside her ears... is far too thunderous to bear.
The entire ceremony is awash with turmoil. She has never once felt the gaze of the surrounding people in such a way before - full of distrust and hostility, like barbs in her back.
Sciurus also seems to be saying something to her, and not in her usual sharp shouts, her lips are silently quivering.
Ratatos can tell from a glance what her voiceless words are. In the past, the two of them played similar tricks without the notice of adults.
Her sister says:
'But, I just wanted to do something for the Browntail clan!'

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Great Elder, what is your opinion?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: *cough*... Your words ring true, Enciodes... *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Great Elder, is there something wrong?

steps.name: Great Elder
steps.text: I'm fine... *gurgle*...

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: Great Elder, what's happening?!

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: There's some green liquid coming from the Great Elder's lips... He's been poisoned!

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: Someone poisoned the Great Elder!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Let me see.

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: Stay back, Saintess! There may be other poison!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: I'm not afraid.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: No... the poison is too potent and is suppressing my healing Arts. I can only barely maintain the Great Elder's life for a while.

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: Who would poison the Great Elder?! And, when...

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: Wine! It must've been that cup of wine that Arctosz offered to the Great Elder!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Bring the cup!

steps.name: Devotee
steps.text: H-Here it is!

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: Without a doubt... there are traces of poison.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That's impossible!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...So that's your game.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Arctosz, I never could've imagined that you would dare poison the Great Elder in your bid to take over Kjerag!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What?! What reason would I possibly have to poison the Great Elder?!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Hmph. The Paleroche clan has always been on good terms with the Vine-Bead Court, but you leveraged this relationship to gain many privileges throughout Kjerag. The people gathered here are all witnesses to that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Over these years, you have used this privilege to suppress me, something I endure to this day. You have all seen this with your own eyes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And now, even as I have compromised by proposing to return temporal power to the Saintess, you still have to terrorize the house of Silverash.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Once the Saintess holds all the power and the three clans are equal under her leadership, will the Paleroche clan still enjoy its privileges as it does now?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Perhaps because the Great Elder was no longer willing to support you, you then chose to contact Madame Sciurus, plotting the scheme unfolding before our very eyes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Madame Sciurus was responsible for assassinating me, you would poison the Great Elder, and the two of you would take advantage of the situation to seize power in Kjerag... Not a bad plan, Arctosz.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You dare slander me, Enciodes!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Slander?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It is a fact that your clan is on good terms with the Vine-Bead Court. It is a fact that the Browntail clan is now allied with yours. It is a fact that the Elders agreed to return temporal power to the Saintess.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: And as of now, it is a fact that you poisoned the Great Elder.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I would ask all of you present to pass judgment – am I the one who slanders, or is Arctosz the one who deceives?!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: But... Sir Arctosz isn't that kind of person...

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: Sir Enciodes was injured during the Holy Hunt, and a Browntail was responsible. Now, Arctosz poisoned the Great Elder. What is there to doubt?

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: I can't believe I had such a wrong impression of Arctosz! I never thought he was faking his piety all these years!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: ...I refuse to believe it!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: Wake up already!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Pin down the murderer and Madame Sciurus.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Right away.

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Get your hands off me, you bastard!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Sciurus!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Matriarch...!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Wait––

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Ice Arts, and from such a long range? Could it be––

steps.name: Kjerag Noble A
steps.text: Who is it?!

steps.name: Kjerag Noble B
steps.text: Look over there!
Warriors, it's time to rescue your clan leader.

steps.name: Kjerag Noble A
steps.text: That's... Gnosis! Why is he here, and, why are the Browntails with him?!

steps.name: Kjerag Noble B
steps.text: I haven't heard from him since he was blacklisted from Karlan Trade. From the looks of things, he's defected to the Browntail clan?!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes, you've gone to such great lengths to paint yourself as some pious victim, making your high-and-mighty proclamations atop that stage of yours. Have you no sense of shame?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I was wondering where you were hiding, Gnosis. Turns out you fell in with Ratatos.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Hiding? No, I've been biding my time for this moment.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Ratatos, what are you hesitating for?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Gnosis, you––

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Take a good look at the people around you, and the distrust they harbor for you in their eyes!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian A
steps.text: Ratatos has betrayed Kjeragandr! She must be punished!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian B
steps.text: Arctosz, I thought better of you!

steps.name: Kjerag Civilian C
steps.text: Strike them down, Sir Enciodes! Strike them down!!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Get a good look at your sister. Enciodes is about to take her away!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Let go! Let go of me!!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Don't you dare hurt my wife!

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Hmph!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Argh...

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Sciurus! Yucatan!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Now is your last chance.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enciodes said that he trusted you. But did he ever actually trust you?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You should've seen through this long ago. He's just forcing you to make a decision. But do you really think you can protect your Browntail clan simply by turning over the 'assassin' that he wants?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Look around you. See how the people are looking at you.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Do you have any idea what will become of your clans should Enciodes take over Kjerag?

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Matriarch!

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Ratatos, don't tell me that you intend to protect neither your clan nor your lands, and instead will simply relinquish your public image and privileges?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If you still choose to do nothing, even at this point...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Then allow me to help you.
Gnosis turns to look at Enciodes.
Ice-blue Arts condense in the palm of his hand, but Enciodes remains unfazed.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Gnosis, you disappoint me.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: What a coincidence, Enciodes. I was just thinking the same thing.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ––Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: As you should know, these Arts are nothing to me.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Alright, don't waste my time.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Let's put you down, Gnosis.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: How pathetic.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Pathetic?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Even if you strike me down here today, it won't do you any good.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You may be able to stop one person, or even a hundred people. But can you stop a thousand? Ten thousand?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Look behind me.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The flames have been lit.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Grr.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Arctosz.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Do you believe me, or Enciodes?!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: I don't trust either of you!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Then you should at least know very clearly now, who the real enemy is!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Browntail clan warriors, prepare for battle!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: First, we rescue Sciurus. Then, bring Enciodes to me!

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior
steps.text: Yes, Matriarch!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Fy faen... Paleroche warriors, in formation!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Take down the traitor! Expose to the masses that Enciodes is the real traitor!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Paleroche Clan Warrior
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Degenbrecher.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Get Gnosis.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You don't need me?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Matterhorn.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Sir.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Take care of the Great Elder and the Saintess.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Right away.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Weiss.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sir.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Bring me Arctosz and Ratatos.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Try to avoid taking any lives. Now isn't the time for that.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: It shall be done.

options: The other possibility seems to have been the correct one.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: So what was all of that?

options: That... was all planned by Enciodes from the very beginning.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Didn't we know that all along?

options: I mean, including Gnosis showing up.

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Kjarr
steps.text: Do you mean that––

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Your orders, Doctor?

options: Enciodes always had contingencies in place.
I need you to rescue Arctosz and Ratatos.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: ...I'm not sure I understand.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: ...I need a reason to act, Doctor. This goes beyond my duty to protect you.

options: At this point, Enciodes has already won.
Even if Arctosz and Ratatos aren't in danger.
Kjerag is bound to undergo tectonic shifts.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: My duty is to uphold Rhodes Island's interests, and protect you.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: And from a practical standpoint, the things going on here have nothing to do with you, Doctor.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Even if Enciodes wins, no harm would come to you, as you are his guest.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: From another perspective, he was the one who formed business ties with Rhodes Island, not the other two clans, let alone Kjerag as a whole.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: If anything, interfering with Enciodes's plans is more likely to threaten Rhodes Island's interests, as well as put your safety at risk.

options: What I am going to do... is prevent wars and save lives.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Doctor, people are dying in every corner of this world.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: If you go around committed to saving people, genuinely devoting yourself to that cause, you're just going to end up overcome with guilt when you fail.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I break with a lot of Rhodes Island when I often find myself thinking that saving and protecting lives is kind of pointless.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I believe in the victories you bring, and the discernable value that comes with those victories.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Kjerag's population is in the millions. The people you are talking about aren't just a few. Not dozens, or hundreds, but tens of thousands, maybe even hundreds of thousands.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: ...Is this the victory you promised today?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Alright. I'll see it done.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Guh...

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Ugh... Launching a sneak attack during the chaos? Don't let them get away!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Sciurus!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Hurry!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Stop!

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Out of the way!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Stand down, Yucatan of the Browntail clan.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: If you come peacefully, the Master will treat you mercifully. He has no interest in taking your lives.

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: (As long as Rus can get away––)

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Yucatan
steps.text: *cough*... Rus, hurry...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Browntail Clan Warrior
steps.text: Hurry, Sciurus!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Yucatan is still back there! And, Monch too!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You're still talking about the assassin? You idiot!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: ...She didn't do anything!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: But Yucatan... What about Yucatan?! He's my husband!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Look at what's going on around you! Yucatan sacrificed everything to save you, and you plan on jumping back into the fire?!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: So you're just going to abandon him?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If I was giving up on him, I wouldn't be fighting back!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Now stop being a damned fool!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: Fine fine, I'll just keep running!

steps.name: Sciurus
steps.text: (Yucatan...)

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Gah... Where'd these freaks and their weird armor come from?

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Sir, Enciodes's forces outnumber us too heavily! We're getting overwhelmed!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: What do we do?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: There are no cowards in the Paleroche clan!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Arctosz, stop trying to play the hero! We need to team up and cut our way out of here!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: How do you expect me to live that down?!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You won't have a say in the matter if you die here!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Dammit... Damn it all!

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Gulo, gather the warriors and follow me! We're going to break out of here!

steps.name: Gulo
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: (*whispers*) Sorry about this.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: The Tschäggättä already have this place surrounded.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You still have the option to surrender before you pass the point of no return.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Lackey of Enciodes, you speak only lies! We will fight our way out!

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I would prefer if you calmed down first. You stand no chance.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: You can't run.
Actually, they can.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Who's there?
A tall man stands in the corner at the entrance of a corridor, under the shadows of the eaves.
Behind him, several Tschäggättä, who were supposed to have the perimeter secured, lie in the corridor.
Out from the shadows strides one of the operators most familiar to Courier during the time he spent at Rhodes Island.
He knows exactly what this means.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: You... Who are you?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: You're... that Doctor's...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Why are you saving us?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: It's not my job to tell you things.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: The exit is this way. I've already dealt with the guards outside.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Aurora, escort them out.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Tschäggättä
steps.text: You aren't getting away!

steps.name: Tschäggättä
steps.text: Urgh...

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Who's next? Try me.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Don't do anything rash! Get in formation!

steps.name: Tschäggättä
steps.text: Get in formation? Just for a single person?

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: GET IN FORMATION!!

steps.name: Tschäggättä
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Very good.

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: Captain Sharp...

steps.name: Weiss
steps.text: I'm so sorry.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: There's no need to apologize to me, Courier. Nothing personal.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: It's just business.
Fifteen minutes later...

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Captain! You... You're injured?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: There were a lot of 'em, and Courier's blade is still pretty quick.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: Captain... Courier, he...

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I spared him, don't worry.

steps.name: Aurora
steps.text: So, what's next?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: We're all done with work over here.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: On to the next job.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: How's the Great Elder doing?

steps.name: Vine-Bead Court Medic
steps.text: It's not looking good.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: Send the Great Elder back to the Vine-Bead Court. Sir Enciodes will arrange for a special doctor.

steps.name: Matterhorn
steps.text: And, great Saintess, Sir Enciodes has invited you to return to the Vine-Bead Court and hold the coronation ceremony again after things have settled down.

steps.name: Enya
steps.text: ...I know.
Enya does not resist. She knows that right now, she does not have the leeway to resist.
From a certain point onward, she has known that this was all staged farce.
And the one who set this farce in motion... was her very own brother.
He ruthlessly shattered all the mental preparations she made for this moment, as well as her vision for the future.
Even if she could take down everyone standing in front of her right now, the people would still ask her to take the position that Enciodes prepared for her in the Vine-Bead Court.
She looks all around her.
When she sees Matterhorn take notice of her gaze, she deliberately looks away.
She sees the combatants clad in modern, cutting-edge equipment tearing through the formation of Silverash warriors, escorting Arctosz and Ratatos away.
She sees the eyes of the people focused on Enciodes, like a rapt audience in front of a theater's master.
She sees the hope and fervor in their eyes.
She sees Kjarr, and she sees the person standing next to her–you.
Your eyes meet, and within them, you see sorrow, reluctance, and–– fury.
All fleeting emotions.
She finally averts her eyes, and takes a step forward.

steps.name: Silverash Clan Warrior
steps.text: Master! Rhodes Islanders suddenly rushed in to help Arctosz and Ratatos escape!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You... always keep me on my toes.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: All this happened in the piddling amount of time it took me to suppress Gnosis?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I must say, Rhodes Island's attack indeed surpassed my expectations. I did consider the possibility of them intervening, but underestimated their strength. This time, it is I whose plans have been forcefully disrupted.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Should I go after them?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: There's no need. I still have a backup plan.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Moreover, whether or not those two die here has no bearing on what I'm going to do next.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname} must've realized as much, to make a decision like this.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: What do you think comes next?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Assuming this Doctor isn't an impulsive fool, then these two still have a role to play.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: As for what comes next...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Since you seem to hold this person in such high regard, then it isn't surprising to me that your Doctor would take advantage of this opportunity to manipulate the two clans into an obstacle for you.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I do not take the Doctor for such a flamboyant daredevil.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You seem to really 'understand' this Doctor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It's just my intuition. My intuition as a chessmaster.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: However, an outsider has rescued the heads of the Paleroche and Browntail clans...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Even I cannot fathom what one can achieve in this situation.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: So, I am most curious as to what comes next.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Of course, if what you said is true, then I eagerly await our match.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Let's just call it a day and shove those thoughts back in your head. You're the victor of today's mess.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Everyone is waiting to hear from the victor.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I know.
The scene left behind by the turmoil has not yet been cleaned up, and the people are heatedly discussing what just took place.
But as Enciodes slowly makes his way to center stage, everyone stops what they are doing, and they all turn to look at him.
The crowd is waiting for him to pen the denouement to this farce.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: People of Kjerag, I am so sorry.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It pains my heart greatly to see such tragic events unfold on a holy day.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But this has given us an opportunity to see who the true traitors are in the land of Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: They are none other than Arctosz and Ratatos!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: They were dissatisfied by the changes brought about by my proposal to relinquish our powers, and tried to assassinate me and poison the Great Elder to seize control of all Kjerag.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Without a doubt, there can be no greater blasphemy to Kjeragandr.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Though they managed to escape justice just now, I swear that this matter shall not end here.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Arctosz and Ratatos will be given fair trial, without fail!

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Though in my heart, I truly wanted to see these individuals captured and brought to justice, I had no intention of starting a conflict.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Kjerag is the land of Kjeragandr, the land of all who dwell in the icy mountains. It does not belong to me.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As such, let it be known to all people of the Paleroche and Browntail clans – there shall be no civil war, as that is something we all are worried about.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Consequently, my Silverash warriors will only be deployed to protect the Vine-Bead Court. We will await the Great Elder's recovery, and then discuss Kjerag's future together with the Saintess.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But, I hope that the people of the Paleroche and Browntail clans can at least clearly see who the true enemies of Kjerag are.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I believe that we will surely find a better path forward when all our interests are aligned.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: When that time comes, we will be able to usher in a better Kjerag.

a.text: People start to chant Enciodes's name, with no concern for the fact that this celebration was meant to culminate in the Saintess's return to power.
From the mountain's summit and the direction of the Vine-Bead Court comes the melodious ringing of a bell.
The bell was supposed to celebrate the coronation of the Saintess, but now, it seems to herald a coming revolution.
